name: Hu Tao Rain Swords
plan: Build Xingqiu's Rain Swords, then switch to Hu Tao for Pyro-infused Normal Attacks and repeated Vaporize; Bennett provides healing and a late damage window. Equip Hu Tao with the spear and attack-cost equipment, preserving Fervent Flames for a decisive reaction.

name: Klee Double Hydro
plan: Use Mona for fast Hydro setup and Xingqiu for Rain Swords, then let Klee's enhanced attacks trigger Vaporize. Match charged-attack parity deliberately and use the weapon, food and attack discounts to extend the finishing turn.

name: Tartaglia Pyronado
plan: Establish Xiangling's Pyronado and Bennett's burst field before committing Tartaglia's melee attacks. Use Pyro resonance on an active-character reaction and finish weakened targets with Tartaglia's burst.

name: Mualani Flamestrider
plan: Set up Mavuika's Pyro follow-up and Nightsoul state, then use Mualani's Sharky Surfboard to land amplified Hydro hits. Abundant Phlogiston and Crown of the Saints reward Nightsoul consumption; the Crocodile supplies Hydro pressure when Mualani cannot safely stay active.

name: Ayaka Yoimiya Melt
plan: Charge Yoimiya's burst, then switch into Ayaka's Cryo infusion and attack repeatedly to trigger Melt with the Pyro follow-up. Chongyun maintains infusion access, while Cryo resonance and attack discounts turn the setup into a concentrated kill round.

name: Ganyu Bennett Melt
plan: Apply Pyro with Guoba or Pyronado and establish Bennett's field, then use Ganyu's Frostflake Arrow to combine Melt damage with standby pressure. Stormterror's Lair and the artifact discount her expensive attacks; time Fervent Flames for the active character's reaction.

name: Wriothesley Furnace
plan: Set up Pyronado and Bennett's field before using Wriothesley's Cryo Normal Attacks to Melt. His HP changes activate Cashflow Supervision and Marechaussee Hunter, helping pay for consecutive attacks while Bennett keeps him alive.

name: Citlali Mavuika Melt
plan: Open Citlali's shield and Itzpapa, then establish Mavuika's Nightsoul state and Pyro pressure to trigger Melt and replenish Citlali through reactions or Select effects. Bennett stabilizes the team; prioritize fighting-spirit generation rather than ordinary Energy cards for Mavuika.

name: Mona Double Anemo Control
plan: Apply Hydro with Mona, then alternate Sucrose and Jean to spread it with Swirl and disrupt the opposing active character. Fast and discounted switches preserve the control loop, while Jean's burst and defensive food sustain the team.

name: Shenhe Anemo Sweep
plan: Create Shenhe's Icy Quill and Faruzan's Anemo damage support, then use Wanderer to Swirl Cryo across the opposing team. Reserve Impetuous Winds for the switch into a damage turn and chain defeats with Fresh Wind of Freedom.

name: Kazuha Electro Diffusion
plan: Start Oz and Yae's Electro summon, then bring Kazuha in to spread Electro and supply his elemental damage buff. Electro resonance accelerates bursts, while reaction dice and inexpensive switches keep the elemental spread going.

name: Ifa Ororon Stormgale
plan: Apply Hydro with Tartaglia and establish Ororon's Electro pressure, then use Ifa's Nightsoul-enabled attacks to Swirl the aura and create additional reactions. Spend Nightsoul resources deliberately and use Fire and War to protect the key Natlan attacker during the finishing round.

name: Ayaka Xingqiu Freeze
plan: Build Xingqiu's burst and switch to Ayaka for Cryo-infused Normal Attacks that repeatedly Freeze the active enemy. Chongyun renews Cryo access; sequence attacks and switches to keep opponents from escaping the damage window.

name: Ganyu Mona Freeze
plan: Use Mona's Hydro application to Freeze the active target, then let Ganyu's charged shots pressure the entire opposing team. Diona supplies a shield and healing; preserve Shattering Ice for a shot or burst that reaches a kill threshold.

name: Escoffier Furina Freeze
plan: Maintain Furina's Hydro summon and Escoffier's Cryo summon, then use Wriothesley's Cryo attacks to Freeze between End Phases. Escoffier's team healing supports HP-change equipment, while People of the Springs extends summon pressure.

name: Skirk Double Cryo Freeze
plan: Use Dahlia's Hydro application and protection to enable Ayaka's Cryo attacks and generate Void Rifts for Skirk through Frozen reactions. Build Skirk's Serpent's Subtlety for a finishing burst; do not spend ordinary Energy acceleration on her.

name: Oceanid Fischl Mirror Maiden
plan: Establish Oceanid's Hydro summons and Oz so their End Phase attacks trigger Electro-Charged and chip standby characters. Mirror Maiden marks an important target, and extended summon usage increases the pressure without exposing one carry for every attack.

name: Cyno Keqing Oceanid
plan: Start Oceanid's Hydro summons, then use Keqing to apply Electro and develop bursts while Cyno's Indwelling level grows. Switch to Cyno for the sustained infused-attack finish, using Electro resonance and attack discounts to extend his turn.

name: Neuvillette Double Electro
plan: Create Oz and Yae's Electro summon before bringing Neuvillette in for Hydro attacks and Electro-Charged damage. His HP consumption and recovery activate Tome of the Eternal Flow and Marechaussee Hunter; Electro resonance supplies burst access for the supporting attackers.

name: Ayato Beidou Rainstorm
plan: Build Beidou's burst and deploy Oz, then use Ayato's Hydro-infused Normal Attacks to combine coordinated Electro hits with Electro-Charged. Protect the active attacker from forced switching and use attack discounts to obtain several follow-ups in one round.

name: Ganyu Keqing Mona Spread
plan: Use Mona to set up Hydro and Keqing to distribute Electro, then fire Ganyu's Cryo attacks into Electro-affected enemies for Superconduct and standby damage. The secondary Hydro reactions give flexible aura setup; finish the weakened board with Ganyu or Keqing's burst.

name: Eula Raiden Diona
plan: Deploy Raiden's Eye and burst to supply Electro and Energy, then build Eula's Lightfall Sword with repeated attacks. Diona protects the setup, and Superconduct chips standby targets while Eula's physical damage and delayed sword finish the active target.

name: Ayaka Yae Cryo Cube
plan: Maintain Yae's Electro summon, then attack with Ayaka's Cryo infusion to trigger Superconduct and spread damage. Cryo Hypostasis provides another Cryo threat and its special revival setup, allowing the deck to continue after Ayaka's attack window closes.

name: Razor Kaeya Diona
plan: Use Kaeya's burst and Diona's Cryo application to set up Superconduct, then commit Razor's burst-enhanced Normal Attacks. Discounted switches trigger Kaeya's follow-up while Razor's weapon converts the resulting chip damage into kill thresholds.

name: Keqing Bennett Pyro Agent
plan: Build Bennett's burst field, use Keqing to apply Electro and force switches with Overloaded, and let Pyro Agent finish low-HP targets. Double Pyro resonance adds a large reaction spike while Keqing's generated skill card helps re-enter the active slot.

name: Chevreuse Clorinde Fischl
plan: Deploy Oz and use Chevreuse to establish Pyro and her Overloaded rewards, then drive reactions with Clorinde's enhanced Normal Attacks. Fragment of Harmonic Whimsy contributes Bond of Life and skill discounts; clear Clorinde's Bond of Life with her skill when she needs healing or damage.

name: Lisa Chevreuse Mavuika
plan: Use Mavuika's Pyro follow-up and Chevreuse's reaction support to enable Lisa's Electro attacks and Overloaded switches. Instructor's Cap rewards active reactions, while Pyro resonance and Lisa's Conductive stacks create the finishing damage window.

name: Yoimiya Beidou Fischl
plan: Set up Beidou's burst and Oz, then use Yoimiya's infused Normal Attacks to trigger Overloaded and coordinated damage. Keep Yoimiya active during the attack round, using Edict of Absolution and attack discounts to protect and extend the combo.

name: Nilou Nahida Baizhu Bloom
plan: Establish Nilou's Bountiful Core effect in this exclusively Hydro/Dendro lineup, then apply Nahida's marks and repeat Bloom reactions. Baizhu's healing and shielding sustain the core engine; Dendro resonance and summon extension turn accumulated reactions into End Phase pressure.

name: Hydro Tulpa Nilou Baizhu
plan: Create Nilou's Bountiful Cores and Baizhu's sustain, then use Hydro Tulpa's skill or burst to trigger summon End Phase effects during the Action Phase. Fell Dragon adds piercing pressure as exhausted supports and summons leave play; monitor Tulpa's self-damage before extending its attack turn.

name: Nahida Xingqiu Kuki Hyperbloom
plan: Build Xingqiu's Rain Swords and use Nahida's Dendro Normal Attacks to generate Bloom, then let Kuki's Electro ring or burst consume Dendro Cores for Hyperbloom. Kuki supplies healing while Nahida's catalyst, reaction artifacts and attack discounts support the driver sequence.

name: Nahida Xingqiu Thoma Burgeon
plan: Use Xingqiu and Nahida to generate Dendro Cores, then activate Thoma's burst for shielding and coordinated Pyro hits that consume the cores through Burgeon. Normal Attack discounts support the follow-up engine, and Thoma's shield protects the character driving it.

name: Emilie Bennett Nahida Burning
plan: Apply Dendro with Nahida and Pyro with Bennett to establish Burning, then deploy Emilie's summon and maintain the reaction. Unfinished Reverie amplifies Burning damage, while Bennett's healing and extended summons support an attrition win.

name: Kinich Mavuika Emilie
plan: Use Mavuika's Pyro pressure and Kinich's linked switches to sustain Burning, then add Emilie's summon for repeated damage. Nightsoul consumption builds Mavuika's Fighting Spirit, and Abundant Phlogiston helps preserve the linked attack engine.

name: Yumkasaur Food Furnace
plan: Feed the Yumkasaur with cheap food and its food-drawing skill to build its non-Satiated scaling, while Bennett and Emilie sustain Burning. Chef Mao and NRE replace food and recover resources; the creature's increasing durability lets Burning and Emilie's summon wear opponents down.

name: Collei Keqing Fischl Quicken
plan: Open Oz, then use Collei's talent skill to establish Dendro and Catalyzing Field before Keqing takes over. Repeated Electro and Dendro hits consume Quicken bonuses, and Instructor's Cap plus King's Squire make the reaction sequence efficient.

name: Tighnari Yae Nahida Spread
plan: Start Yae's Electro summon and Nahida's marks, then use Tighnari's Dendro-infused charged attacks to trigger Spread and create his follow-up summon. Preserve charged-attack parity and use Dendro resonance to refresh reaction pressure.

name: Alhaitham Nahida Raiden
plan: Establish Raiden's Electro Eye and Nahida's marks, then use Alhaitham's Dendro infusion for repeated Spread damage. Raiden's burst accelerates the team's normal Energy requirements, while Foliar Incision and attack food extend Alhaitham's active round.

name: Kirara Keqing Fischl Aggravate
plan: Apply Dendro with Kirara and deploy Oz, then use Keqing's skill and burst to exploit Catalyzing Field. Kirara's shield and switching mechanics let the team reapply auras without leaving Keqing exposed throughout the setup.

name: Navia Mona Golden Wolflord
plan: Apply Hydro with Mona, then use Navia and Golden Wolflord to Crystallize while generating Navia's Shrapnel resources. Geo shields absorb retaliation, and Wolflord's corrosion pressures the standby characters while Navia converts generated cards into finishing attacks.

name: Noelle Xingqiu Albedo
plan: Build Xingqiu's burst and Albedo's summon before using Noelle's burst for Geo-infused attacks and Hydro Crystallize. Noelle's talent healing and Geo resonance support a durable carry turn, with Normal Attack discounts extending the burst.

name: Zhongli Chiori Pyro Bird
plan: Establish Zhongli's shield and Chiori's chosen doll, then apply Pyro with the Qucusaur for Crystallize and summon pressure. Extend useful summons and let Fell Dragon grow as exhausted summons and supports leave the field, keeping Zhongli as the protected anchor.

name: Navia Kachina Lyney
plan: Use Lyney's Pyro application before Navia's Geo hits to produce Crystallize and Shrapnel, with Kachina supplying Nightsoul-based Geo pressure. Spend Abundant Phlogiston on Kachina's technique sequence and save the weapon-enhanced Navia attacks for damaged targets.

name: Mono Pyro Bennett Lyney Agent
plan: Build Bennett's field and Lyney's Prop Surplus while Pyro Agent trades safely through stealth. Use Woven Flames for extra actions and direct Pyro pressure for kills; omit Fervent Flames because this lineup cannot generate an elemental reaction on its own.

name: Mono Hydro Furina Neuvillette Sigewinne
plan: Set up Furina's summons and use Sigewinne to heal and sustain Neuvillette's Hydro attack cycle. HP changes fuel Neuvillette's equipment, while Hydro resonance and Water and Justice keep the whole team healthy without requiring reactions.

name: Mono Cryo Ayaka Shenhe Chongyun
plan: Create Shenhe's Icy Quill and maintain Cryo infusion with Ayaka or Chongyun, then attack repeatedly through Normal Attack discounts. Shattering Ice provides a direct damage spike without needing a reaction, and Shenhe's burst supports the finishing round.

name: Mono Electro Raiden Yae Sara
plan: Deploy Raiden's Eye and Yae's summon, then use Raiden's burst to recharge teammates for successive bursts. Sara adds damage support, while Electro resonance and Emblem of Severed Fate reinforce the burst chain rather than relying on reactions.

name: Mono Anemo Xiao Faruzan Xianyun
plan: Charge Faruzan's support burst, then activate Xiao's burst and use Xianyun with Plunging Strike to extend his damage sequence. Anemo resonance supplies dice and fast switches; this lineup wins through supported Anemo damage rather than assuming access to Swirl.

name: Mono Geo Itto Gorou Albedo
plan: Establish Albedo's summon and Gorou's Geo support, then use Itto's burst and charged attacks to finish the enemy lineup. Manage Superlative Superstrength and charged-attack parity, using Geo resonance and attack discounts to protect and extend Itto's turn.

name: Mono Dendro Alhaitham Collei Yaoyao
plan: Use Yaoyao's summon for healing and Collei for direct Dendro damage, then let Alhaitham drive Dendro-infused attacks. Woven Weeds and Deepwood Memories improve dice efficiency; omit Sprawling Greenery because this lineup cannot create its required reaction statuses by itself.

name: Clorinde Citlali Mavuika Nightsoul
plan: Open Citlali's shield and Mavuika's Pyro follow-up, then use Clorinde's discounted Normal Attacks to trigger reactions and build Mavuika's Fighting Spirit. Clorinde's Bond of Life equipment sustains the attack engine, and Fire and War protects a Natlan teammate in a lethal round.

name: Citlali Chiori Mavuika Selection
plan: Use Chiori's doll selection and Mavuika's Flamestrider selection to activate Citlali's Select-based Nightsoul recovery. Sustain Cryo and Pyro summon pressure with incidental Crystallize shields, choosing summons for the current board rather than spending Energy cards on Mavuika.

name: Oceanid Fischl Xiangling Summon Cascade
plan: Deploy Oceanid's Hydro summons, Oz and Guoba to produce Electro-Charged, Vaporize and Overloaded during End Phases. Respect the summon-zone limit and extend the most useful summon; Fell Dragon can convert exhausted summon and support turnover into extra piercing damage.

name: Raiden Eula Shenhe Burst Relay
plan: Use Raiden's Eye and burst to recharge Eula and Shenhe, then combine Shenhe's Cryo support with Eula's burst and Lightfall Sword. Superconduct provides standby chip, while energy transfer and burst equipment create a second burst window after the initial setup.

name: Fatui Frost Signora Thunder
plan: Use Frost Operative's pressure and Thunder Manifestation's Electro attacks for Superconduct, with Fatui Conspiracy supplying additional elemental applications. Signora provides a second life stage and changes to Pyro after her transformation, enabling a late switch from Cryo pressure into Melt or Overloaded.

name: Consecrated Beast Discard Engine
plan: Cycle the beasts' generated blocks and use their discard rewards while applying Hydro, Electro and Dendro for a reaction-heavy attack sequence. Conductor's Top Hat, Central Laboratory Ruins and Flying Squad turn discarded high-cost cards into resources, while discarded Countdown becomes progressively cheaper.

name: Budget Diluc Kaeya Sucrose
plan: Apply Cryo with Kaeya before Diluc's Pyro skill for Melt, then use Sucrose to spread a useful elemental aura. Simple weapons, skill healing, rerolls and food support straightforward sequencing; this budget training deck uses no Arcane Legend or elaborate generated-card engine.

name: Budget Collei Fischl Keqing
plan: Deploy Oz and follow with Collei's talent skill to create Quicken, then let Keqing exploit Catalyzing Field and finish weakened enemies. Cheap reaction dice, basic weapons and direct damage food keep the plan accessible without a complex support engine.

name: Budget Barbara Kaeya Chongyun
plan: Use Barbara's Hydro application before Kaeya's Cryo skill to Freeze, then let Chongyun provide Cryo infusion for repeated attacks. Kaeya's talent and Barbara's healing stabilize the team, while inexpensive equipment and Cryo resonance support a clear control plan.

name: Budget Noelle Ningguang Fischl
plan: Deploy Oz to apply Electro, then use Ningguang or Noelle to Crystallize and protect the active character. Build Noelle's burst for the finishing attack round, using her talent and basic healing equipment to sustain the carry.
